items.title: Rutherford County displaces Hamilton as state’s 4th-biggest county
items.summary: New population projections released Monday show that Rutherford County, south of Nashville, is bigger than Hamilton County for the first time ever, moving Hamilton down from the state's fourth-biggest county to the fifth.
